mapper.select: SELECT r.role_code, r.role_name, r.status, gt.create_time, gt.update_time FROM grant_table gt INNER JOIN sys_role r ON r.role_code = gt.role_code WHERE gt.subject_type = #{subjectType} AND gt.subject_id = #{subjectId} ORDER BY r.role_code

SELECT gt.subject_id AS user_id, u.username, u.nickname, u.employee_no, u.status AS user_status, gt.create_time, gt.update_time FROM grant_table gt INNER JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = gt.subject_id AND u.is_deleted = 0 WHERE gt.role_code = #{roleCode} AND gt.subject_type = 'USER' ORDER BY u.username

SELECT gt.subject_id AS dept_id, d.dept_code, d.dept_name, d.status, gt.create_time, gt.update_time FROM grant_table gt INNER JOIN sys_dept d ON d.id = gt.subject_id AND d.is_deleted = 0 WHERE gt.role_code = #{roleCode} AND gt.subject_type = 'DEPT' ORDER BY d.dept_code

SELECT gt.subject_id AS post_id, p.post_code, p.post_name, p.status, p.dept_id, d.dept_name, gt.create_time, gt.update_time FROM grant_table gt INNER JOIN sys_post p ON p.id = gt.subject_id AND p.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON d.id = p.dept_id AND d.is_deleted = 0 WHERE gt.role_code = #{roleCode} AND gt.subject_type = 'POST' ORDER BY p.post_code
